ctx.x: In other words, Ernest Opanyo was always the original drum player of the tuxedo band. After they come out from there, well, they played out the field a while and they went to Jack Sheen. Yeah. So after they come back from there, after the engagement finished out with Jack Sheen, well, his feet commence to going back. Well, he tried to get me, but he couldn't get me, so he got Henry Zeno. Oh, yeah. Happened to Henry Zeno, he didn't play anymore in about five months. And he died and I went over and took the play.
Wasn't Al Nicholas with Ory about the time you were with Ory?
